user_query: I'm organizing a virtual conference and I want to inject some humor into the event. Can you provide me with a mix of manatee jokes, chuck Norris jokes, and funny gifs? This will help keep the attendees engaged and entertained.

TaskList.description: Fetch a collection of manatee jokes to incorporate into the conference.
Fetch a collection of Chuck Norris jokes to add variety to the humor content.
Search and retrieve funny GIFs that match the theme of humor to keep attendees engaged.
Compile all fetched jokes and GIFs into a presentation format for the virtual conference.
